title: MRC HOT TROT Powered by Rox and On
description: THE MRC HOT TROT IS BACK FOR ROUND TWO. MRC'S second annual take on the classic Turkey Trot. Get excited for the holidays and celebrate MRC style: run the 3, 6 or 10 mile run. Fastest Male and Fastest Female to run the 5km WINS the Hot Trot and gets a turkey (and glory).

title: Open Intelligence: A documentary premiere
description: What does "actually open AI" look like? This short documentary traces the inference layer of AI: the infrastructure that determines whether AI can run affordably and at scale.

title: Recursive Self Improvement Hack: Autonomous Agent Businesses
description: Sundai: - a room full of people building moonshots - every sunday. - born out of MIT & Harvard. 135+ hacks. - aspire to beat the norm. aim higher. ------ the loop is already spinning. More than 90% of Anthropic's code is written by Claude. Direction-setting is the role left for humans. Or...agents?

title: Bryce 3D Live: make art with 30 year old software | co-presented by Culture Slop
description: Inspired by the VFX collective Corridor Crew’s video “Can modern VFX Artists use 90’s software?”, we’re hosting a Bryce 3D Live event here in San Francisco. 10 artists with different practices will be making live worlds and scenes with Bryce 7.1 on a collection of 15-year-old working iMac G5s donated to TIAT from the Internet Archive.

title: BREAKATHON by BotGauge: Bring your agent. Lets break it.
description: Think your AI agent is ready for the real world? Let’s find out. BREAKATHON is an in-person AI agent testing challenge for people who build agents. Bring your agent, or build one at the event, and BotGauge will put it through live adversarial testing to find weaknesses, security gaps and unexpected behaviour. The challenge Entry is $20.

title: Durable AI Meetup (November Edition)
description: Join us for the next edition of the Durable AI Meetup series! What's Happening: 🎤 Lightning talks & demos from engineers building the layers around production agents 🤝 Networking with engineers and founders shipping agents into production 🍽️ Food, drinks, and real technical conversations Agenda: 5:30 PM – Doors open | Food, drinks, networking 6:00 PM –…

title: Degrees of Freedom: Embodied AI Builders Night @ Mission Robotics
description: It's the return of Degrees of Freedom, the builders night for the Embodied AI community. Bring the gripper you built at your kitchen table, the sim that runs beautifully until you try it on hardware, or the policy you’ve been training on your laptop. For two hours, the builders at the next bench are your labmates. We’ll start at 6 by going around the room.

title: SF Non-Slop Hackathon | Pangram x Kino x Capy x Paper
description: Aesthetics can now be generated cheaply. That makes taste all the more worthwhile to build thoughtfully. Non-slop is a one day hackathon where you use AI to build something intentional that makes people feel something. Theme: What matters when you can generate anything? Can you explain your choices?

title: Agentic Workflows Show & Tell
description: We want everyone to come show off their coolest agentic workflows. Not "here's a tool I built," but "here's how I'm working with agents right now, and you can copy it." It doesn't have to be development: coding, growth, sales, ops, research, and personal workflows are all fair game.

title: Clay & Play
venue: The Love Potion Library - Books, Tea, Wine
description: 🎨 Clay & Play @ The Love Potion Library: Book Ends 🗓 November 24th: ⏰ 6:00pm- 8:00pm. Instructions will begin at 6:10pm** 📍The Love Potion Library During this workshop we are learning how to create your own book ends at one of the cutest books stores in San Francisco. Come learn the basics to create your own of a kind pieces!

title: ML Suds & Science: Who's Running the Lab?
description: Welcome to a special "Who’s Running the Lab?" edition of ML Suds & Science: a gathering for people in the trenches of AI-driven research: autonomous experimentation, robotic lab integration, workflow automation, and everything that gets lost between the Nature abstract and the gap between a paper, a product and the next experiment.

title: Physical AI Hack
description: Physical AI is moving into the real world as we always imagined. Machines can now handle objects with real dexterity, feel what they touch, coordinate their whole body, and adapt on the fly. The question is how far we can push it. Not just better robots, but any system that can perceive, reason, and act reliably in the physical world.

title: Christmas Candle Making Workshop
venue: The Love Potion Library - Books, Tea, Wine
description: Get ready to pour, swirl, and sparkle your way into the holiday season! The Love Potion Library is teaming up with Rana from Bella Candle Shop for a Christmas candle making workshop where you'll make a candle to take home (or wrap up as a gift, if you can bear to part with it).

title: Personal AI Agents Builders Meetup # 5
description: Selective high-signal meetup for folks building personal AI agents. This event is for people who want to learn from other builders and be at the edge of the personal AI agents space. The venue only permits folks 21+; please carry your ID!

title: Omarchy SF
description: Join the Omarchy meetup in San Francisco • Food + Drinks • Tech Talk • Community Demos • Chat We meet in San Francisco to talk Omarchy, Linux, and open source, and to connect with people who think Linux can be fun, beautiful, and actually good with agents. Bring your laptop and show what you’ve built with Omarchy.

title: FastMCP Meetup
description: Join the FastMCP community at GitHub HQ in San Francisco on Wednesday, December 2 for an evening of talks and conversation. Our speakers build MCP servers and agent tooling every day, and they're bringing what they've learned to share with the room.

title: Blueprint II Demo Day
description: Blueprint II Demo Day After 10 weeks of building, testing, soldering, and shipping, the Blueprint II founders are ready to show what they’ve built. Join Founders Inc.

title: super{set} Hackathon: Making Agents Reliable in the Enterprise
description: December 4 | 9-Hour Hackathon | Hosted by super{set} About the Hackathon AI agents are becoming increasingly capable, but deploying them in the enterprise introduces a different set of challenges: How do you make them reliable, observable, secure, and scalable? Join super{set} for a 9-hour hackathon focused on Making Agents Reliable in the Enterprise.

title: Book Swap+ Movie Night!
venue: The Love Potion Library - Books, Tea, Wine
description: We are hosting a book swap and movie night with the bookish creator Angelina @letyourwiferead ! Bring New or Lightly Used books to swap out, have a drink and get into the holiday spirit with other fellow book lovers. At 7pm we will put on a rom-com holiday movie! You can enjoy some cozy treats and good laughs!

title: San Francisco | Claude Community x Release Before Ready
description: Claude San Francisco Build Day: Release Before Ready 🌉 One Saturday, twelve hours and a room full of builders shipping things with Claude before they feel ready. Come build, come play and see how far you can get in a day.

title: Sapiens: A hackathon for human intelligence
description: Sapiens is a one-day San Francisco hackathon for AI that improves human intelligence. You have eight hours to build a tool that helps someone learn, think, remember, speak, or perceive better with or without AI. The Tracks Learning: Build understanding that lasts. Thinking: Improve human judgement. Reason better and challenge what you've missed.

title: Paint & Yap👩‍🎨🎨
description: Join Nous at Paint & Yap 🎨 A little painting and a whole lot of yapping at Duboce Park!🌲🐕 We’ll follow a beginner-friendly painting tutorial together🎨👩‍🎨, step by step, with plenty of pauses to chat and get creative.🖼️ We’ll bring the painting supplies; you bring yourself and your creative energy ✨ Have a favorite paintbrush or a mysteriously specific shade…

title: Folk Art Tin Embossing
description: Join me for a cozy, communal evening of creating folk-art inspired embossed metal ornaments. You'll leave with a fresh set of holiday decorations. Come with a friend or make one here! It’s a great way to get creative, meet new people, and connect. This isn’t an artist-led workshop, but a cozy, guided craft night.

title: tree study (zine makin' #4)
description: ive always loved the panhandle trees and lately ive been wanting to spend some time appreciating them join me for some group zine time in the park~ we'll each get a tree or a couple!! or something instructions + prompt @1:00pm, but bring ur lunch or a snack for a picnic at noon(ish) also bring a clipboard!!

title: Demo Night @ WorkOS (December)
description: Whether it's a side project, an internal tool, an open source project, or a startup, this is your chance to show what you've been working on and see what others have created. The only rules: Live demos only No slides No company pitches Come share your work, get feedback, and meet fellow builders in the community.

title: Claude Community x Apify | Claude Holiday Build Day
description: Claude Holiday Build Day: Build Yourself a Gift 🎁 It's wish list season. This year, skip the wishing and build it yourself. One evening in San Francisco to make the thing you'd love to unwrap, with Claude doing the heavy lifting and a room full of builders doing the same. Expect gifts and surprises along the way. Santa beards optional.

title: GTM Series #05: Jason Lemkin, SaaStr AI
description: Next up in Granola's GTM Series, where we bring in the best GTM leaders to chat with Granola's VP of Sales, Bardia Shahali! Joining us for our next chat will be Jason Lemkin! Jason is the founder of SaaStr AI, the world's largest community for SaaS and B2B founders, and a veteran investor who has put over $200M into B2B startups.

title: WorkOS Agent Night - Holiday Special
description: ❄️ O come, all ye agents, joyful and autonomous ❄️ Our flagship event is back for a holiday edition at the historic Regency Ballroom: one night at the frontier of agentic AI, hosted by the people building it. Live demos, sharp discussions, and hallway conversations worth leaving the fireplace for. 🎟️ Space is limited. RSVP today.

title: Assistant Benchmark Presents: Agent Wars
description: What can today’s AI agents actually do? Join Merit and a16z in San Francisco on December 9 for an evening with the founders and teams building the next generation of consumer AI agents. We’re putting agents to the test on the same real-world tasks, with their experiences shown side by side.

title: Notion Market
description: Shop local this holiday season at Notion HQ! A holiday market inside the Notion HQ office on SF, featuring 10+ small businesses that run on Notion. Browse their goods, meet the people behind them, and participate in craft activities to create customized gifts for the holiday season. How it works Show up and shop.

title: mosaic coaster workshop | mission bernal heights
description: broken tiles. slow hands. unplug. bazi's mosaic night is two hours of broken Heath Ceramic tiles, vibey atmosphere, music, and the kind of room where strangers turn into friends by the end of the night. you'll DIY 4 large mosaic coasters to take home — your design, your colors, your weird. all materials provided. no experience needed.

title: 140th SF Hardware Meetup | Holiday Party @ Studio 45
description: Join us for our 140th SF Hardware Meetup Holiday Party! 🤖 Bring physical demos for open mic! It can be products, prototypes, components, or anything physical.

title: The Great Business Bake Off: an AI Agent Hackathon
description: The Great Business Bake Off is Theory Ventures' second annual AI agent hackathon. You inherit a bakery business, and you and your team of AI agents have five hours to make it the most profitable bakery in town. The Challenge Your agents connect to the bakery, dig through its history, and help you decide what to do.

title: 🎅 Santa’s Agenthon: Build Agents, Save Christmas.
description: Santa’s workshop got hacked. The naughty list leaked. Gift orders are a mess. The elves are locked out. And someone gave an AI agent access to EVERYTHING. Christmas is in 12 days. We need engineers. On December 13, we’re bringing together 200 engineers in San Francisco to rebuild Santa’s workshop with AI agents.

title: Holidaze Market & Light Up the Night Party!
description: It's your last chance to party at The Box Shop in 2026 -- and get some holiday shopping done with our artists and builders! Expect music, festive lights from Entwined, a poofing Fire Garden, exploring, dancing and celebrating another big year with our community. This event is FREE with RSVP - invite your friends!

title: Banff Mountain Film Festival World Tour - San Francisco
description: Welcome to the Banff Mountain Film Festival! Get ready for a night of jaw-dropping adventure films that will leave you inspired to conquer the great outdoors. This in-person event will be held at the Palace of Fine Arts Theatre, where you can immerse yourself in stories of epic climbs, daring descents, and awe-inspiring landscapes.

title: Agentic AI Hackathon 2.0 - SF
description: 🎉Agentic AI Hackathon – 8-Hour Hackathon at AWS Builder Loft, SF 🎉 Join us for Agentic AI Hackathon in SF, an electrifying 8-hour hackathon bringing together the brightest minds in tech, creativity, and innovation — all under one roof at the iconic AWS Builder Loft in San Fransisco!
